scope: Exact resource ownership for SDK cleanup notifications and share-cache generations; full G0 and feature gates remain open
implemented: SDK LOGOFF and TREE_DISCONNECT events match the originating Session/TreeConnect by reference identity. Subscribers conditionally remove only the entry observed, preserving unrelated peers and replacement generations with reused numeric IDs.
Tree cache removal clears a share-name alias only if it still points to the removed Share. Registering a reused tree ID removes its obsolete name alias without dropping other live IDs.

Weak event owners avoid retaining session keys and credentials through stored notifications. Collected scoped events remain no-ops. Legacy numeric constructors and inherited value equality remain compatible.
